decisions.name: Check_All_Requirements_Met
decisions.description: Evaluates if all three prerequisites (Accepted Quote, Contract, and Customer Commitment) exist and the current Handoff_Status__c is not already 'READY' or 'ACCEPTED', routing to READY path when all conditions are met to proceed with S4 to D1 handoff gate validation

rules.name: READY
rules.description: Routes to READY path when all three record lookups returned at least one record (Accepted Quote, Contract, and Customer Commitment exist) AND the current Handoff_Status__c is not 'READY' and not 'ACCEPTED'
rules.label: READY

decisions.label: Check All Requirements Met

recordCreates.name: Create_Handoff_Task
recordCreates.description: Creates a high-priority Task record assigned to the Opportunity owner to review and accept the S4 to D1 handoff after all prerequisites (Accepted Quote, Contract, and Customer Commitment) are met
recordCreates.label: Create Handoff Task

value.stringValue: S4 to D1 Handoff - review and accept

recordLookups.description: Queries Quote object to find any Accepted Quote related to the triggering Opportunity, determining if at least one accepted quote exists as a prerequisite for S4 to D1 handoff gate validation
recordLookups.label: Find Accepted Quote
recordLookups.name: Find_Accepted_Quote

recordLookups.description: Queries Contract object to find any Contract related to the triggering Opportunity via Source_Opportunity__c field, determining if at least one contract exists as a prerequisite for S4 to D1 handoff gate validation
recordLookups.label: Find Related Contract
recordLookups.name: Find_Related_Contract

recordLookups.description: Queries Customer_Commitment__c object to find any Customer Commitment related to the triggering Opportunity, determining if at least one customer commitment exists as a prerequisite for S4 to D1 handoff gate validation
recordLookups.label: Find Customer Commitment
recordLookups.name: Find_Customer_Commitment

recordUpdates.name: Update_Opportunity_to_READY
recordUpdates.description: Updates the triggering Opportunity's Handoff_Status__c field to 'READY' when all three prerequisites (Accepted Quote, Contract, and Customer Commitment) exist, marking the opportunity ready for S4 to D1 handoff gate review
recordUpdates.label: Update Opportunity to READY
